description: This is a C++ source file implementing a fuzzing test for the quiche QUIC protocol framer, including packet header construction, framer setup, and packet processing logic.

classes.name: QuicSelfContainedPacketHeader
classes.description: A specialized QuicPacketHeader with built-in storage for diversification nonce.

classes.name: FuzzingFramerVisitor
classes.description: A custom framer visitor that counts successful public header processing and packet decryption.

methods.name: ConsumePacketHeaderFormat
methods.description: Determines packet header format based on version and provider input.

methods.name: ConsumeParsedQuicVersion
methods.description: Selects a QuicVersion from predefined versions based on provider input.

methods.name: ConsumeQuicPacketHeader
methods.description: Constructs a randomized QuicPacketHeader with appropriate fields for fuzzing.

methods.name: SetupFramer
methods.description: Initializes a QuicFramer with visitor, encrypters, and decrypters based on version.
